seo.title: Tally 2.0: invoicing for freelancers, launch week pricing
seo.description: Tally 2.0 turns tracked hours into a sent invoice in under a minute. Recurring invoices, payment reminders and clean exports. Launch pricing this week.

props.headline: Send the invoice before you close the laptop
props.subheadline: Tally turns the hours you tracked today into an invoice your client can pay by card or transfer. 2.0 adds recurring invoices, automatic reminders and exports your accountant can open without asking you questions.

props.heading: What changed in 2.0
props.intro: Most of these came straight from support emails. If you asked for one of them, thank you.

items.title: Recurring invoices
items.text: Retainers go out on the 1st, or every other Friday, with the right line items and the hours you tracked attached.

items.title: Polite reminders
items.text: Choose when Tally nudges a client about an unpaid invoice: 3 days before, on the due date, a week late. You can edit every email.

items.title: Card and bank transfer
items.text: Clients pay from the invoice link. Payouts go straight to your account; Tally never holds the money.

items.title: Exports that make sense
items.text: CSV and PDF exports grouped by client and tax rate, so the quarterly call with your accountant takes ten minutes.

items.title: Multi-currency
items.text: Invoice in the client's currency and see totals in yours, using the exchange rate from the day the invoice was paid.

items.title: Your data, exportable
items.text: Everything you put in Tally can be downloaded as JSON at any time. No support ticket needed.

items.quote: Recurring invoices alone saved me the first-of-the-month ritual of copying last month's invoice and fixing the dates.
items.name: Priya Raman

items.quote: I turned on reminders for two clients who always paid late. Both paid on time the next month and I never had to write the awkward email.
items.name: Daniel Okafor

items.quote: My accountant asked which tool made the export. That has never happened before.
items.name: Lucía Ferreira

items.question: I'm on Tally 1.x. Do I have to pay again?
items.answer: No. Existing subscriptions move to 2.0 automatically at the price you already pay. The Lifetime plan is new and optional.

items.question: What happens when the launch timer runs out?
items.answer: The timer is counted from your first visit to this page. When it reaches zero, the Yearly plan goes back to $120 and the Lifetime plan is no longer offered.

items.question: Does Tally take a cut of payments?
items.answer: No. You connect your own payment account and pay its normal processing fee. Tally doesn't add a percentage on top.

items.question: Can I leave and take my data with me?
items.answer: Yes. Settings → Export downloads every client, invoice and time entry as JSON and CSV. It works even after your plan ends.

items.question: What is the refund policy?
items.answer: Email us within 30 days of paying and we refund the full amount. You don't need to give a reason.
